events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, and its impact on global geopolitics is significant. The US and its allies are involved, and the situation is volatile. The Atlantic Council has outlined four possible scenarios for the aftermath of the war.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased defense spending and a boost to the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, emerging markets may be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed
